sloka: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः ।कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः ।। ५.३८.४६।।।।
transliteration: bhrāturādeśamādāya lakṣmaṇo vā parantapaḥ ।kasya hetorna māṁ vīraḥ paritrāti mahābalaḥ ।। 5.38.46।।।।

translations.english: "Or, why does the mighty hero, Lakshmana, who is a scorcher of enemies, not come to my rescue taking the orders from his brother?
